backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app, defining types and state for festivals, panchang, aartis, shlokas, temples, community posts, jap counters, and kathas, with public functions for user profiles, approval management, jap tracking, community posts, and katha CRUD operations.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that seeds the kathayen map with initial approved Vrat Katha entries (Santoshi Mata, Solah Somvar, and others) if the map is empty, otherwise returns existing state unchanged.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their IDs, titles, associated files, component dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels for the Hindu devotional app build.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes including colors for background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (Home, Panchang, Jap, Mandir, Profile, Community, AartiDetail, AdminPanel, AIGuru, Kathayen, KathaDetail), wrapped in ThemeProvider and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Presentational card component that renders a linked aarti item with an emoji icon, name, and styled container navigating to the aarti detail route.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Shared layout component that wraps all pages with a bottom navigation bar and conditionally shows a profile setup modal for authenticated users without a profile.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with links to seven app sections (Home, Panchang, Jap, Kathayen, Mandir, AI Guru, Profile), highlighting the active route with saffron styling.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Displays a single chat message bubble for either a user or AI role, with avatar, timestamp, and basic markdown rendering (bold and newlines).
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Shows an animated three-dot typing indicator with the AI Guru avatar, used while waiting for an AI response.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Fetches and displays a daily dharma quote in English and Hindi with author attribution, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita verse if none is returned.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Displays a countdown card for the next upcoming Hindu festival and provides a button to generate and download a shareable PNG image of the countdown.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Renders a linked card for a Katha (story) item showing its category badge, deity, title, and a truncated Hindi text preview.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, handling loading states and re-authentication edge cases.
frontend/src/components/PremiumBanner.ts: Displays a dismissible promotional banner advertising Sanatan Pro Premium with a list of benefits and an upgrade call-to-action button.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that prompts newly authenticated users to enter their name and saves it as their user profile via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with Hindi and English meanings, offering copy, share, and downloadable image generation functionality.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: A dashboard component for Hindu fasting/vrat tracking that displays Brahma Muhurat time, a daily fasting check-in button, countdowns to Ekadashi and Maha Shivratri, and a Navratri day progress tracker, persisting state in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch component that enables or disables 'Vrat Mode' (fasting mode), displaying a label in Devanagari script and a status description based on the enabled state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: A custom React hook managing AI chat state, including message history, loading state, sending user messages via getAIResponse, clearing chat, and auto-scrolling to the latest message.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the ICP backend, covering user profiles, dharma quotes, festivals, panchang data, and more.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: A custom React hook wrapping the Web Speech API to provide play, pause, resume, and stop controls for text-to-speech narration, with playing/paused state tracking and cleanup on unmount.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind base/components/utilities, defines CSS custom properties for a luxury Hindu-themed light/dark color scheme, and declares animation keyframes for gold effects and particles.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Client-side AI response engine that matches user queries against regex patterns across Hindu mythology, philosophy, and other domains, returning templated multi-language responses with a simulated delay.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for a Vedic astrology feature, including all 12 rashis (zodiac signs) with metadata and multilingual prediction templates for love, career, and other life aspects.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Provides static Katha (Hindu story) data as a typed array, currently containing a detailed Hindi-language narrative of Krishna Leela covering birth, childhood miracles, and major episodes.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Contains static data for Hindu shlokas and aartis (devotional hymns), including full Hindi and English transliterated texts for Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, and other deities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with React Query and Internet Identity (ICP authentication) providers wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single Aarti entry looked up by route param, displaying Hindi/English text with a language toggle, plus copy and native share functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only panel (guarded by useIsCallerAdmin) with tabbed UI for approving/rejecting users, assigning roles, adding Dharma quotes, and adding Panchang entries via form inputs.
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: A full-screen AI chat page featuring a saffron-themed header, scrollable message list, suggested questions, auto-resizing textarea input, and a scroll-to-bottom button, powered by the useAIChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community feed page showing seed posts with like/report actions, a compose dialog for new posts (pending approval), and an access-request flow tied to Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Authenticated user dashboard that redirects unauthenticated visitors to home, shows a profile setup modal when no profile exists, and displays a welcome card with navigation guidance.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page featuring a hero banner with today's tithi and greeting, upcoming festival alert, festival countdown, daily Aarti cards, Shloka card, Dharma quote, and a Vrat mode toggle.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: A Jap (chanting) counter page that tracks mantra repetitions up to 108, supports authenticated (ICP backend) and local storage modes, and shows falling petal animations and leaderboard on completion.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single Katha (sacred story) fetched from the backend or static fallback, with Hindi/English language toggle, and text-to-speech narration controls.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Listing page for all Kathayen (sacred stories) with search, category tabs (All/Puranik/Vrat), and a hero banner, falling back to static data if the backend returns nothing.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Temple finder page that links to Google Maps for nearby Hindu temples and displays a static list of famous temples with live darshan and directions buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Hindu calendar (Panchang) page showing today's tithi, nakshatra, muhurat, Rahu Kaal, and upcoming festivals, using backend data with static fallbacks and an Ekadashi reminder toggle.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: React page displaying the user's profile, including avatar, display name, Internet Identity principal, JAP stats, Vrat mode toggle, premium banner, and settings/admin links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters (supporting both regular and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom colors (saffron, gold, cream), border radii, box shadows, font families, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the spiritual/religious app's architecture, known issues (missing Vrat Katha content, broken TTS narration), and existing feature definitions with requirements.
